review_scope: Independent QA of methodology and scoring, not a claim of any superiority

gates.criterion: Author source, pinned code and checkpoint, documented preprocessing and output, modifications named separately
Image-only, shared-observation and oracle tracks separated
Gold visible domain fixed before predictions and all scheduled cases retained
No scale/shear/affine or dense gold registration. Any discrete gauge labelled and equally applied
Original fallback, partial coordinates, actual dewarp, failed and unsupported distinguished
Image-only output not assigned an invented dense physical map
Same original observations, native and matched-budget tracks, density and interpolation documented
G/W/C/R including undefined R, invalid outputs and patient grouping retained
Pitch, orientation, ID, overlap and severe-error tails explicitly evaluated
Common extractor versus native pipelines separate, printed windows and shifts specified
Analytic controls independently generated, real dense truth not assumed
Timeout, memory, retries and full pipeline timing scope frozen

metric_oracle.metric_version: M3 counts accepted nonfinite coordinates as wrong, unlike M2

strict_promotion_gate.required: Paired evidence over each executable named comparator on appropriate shared tasks, preserved content and stated failure budget. Small diagnostic results are descriptive, not final superiority.
strict_promotion_gate.unavailable_products: never converted to a failed run or reconstructed commercial score

user_authorization: The user already authorized comparative experiments. These are internal evidence-quality gates, not an additional permission request.
protocol_design_review: Cleared for the already-inspected diagnostic panel. Primary translation only, secondary D4, explicit operational RGB gate and16M common output budget. Final receipt binds frozen copy.

production_metric_core_review.scope: Analytic scoring, origin/D4 separation, footprint, patient pairing and query-contract checks only

restoration_and_visibility_review.scope: Exported renderer material support with recorded post-noise hard occlusion removed. Not independent real-camera visibility truth, not verification of every renderer occluder or optical effect.

orchestrator_review.deadline_limit: Cooperative SIGALRM is not proof of hard preemption inside a native C/C++ operation.
